items.title: io.github.stationdevx:arena-junit 5.1.1 发布, JUnit integration for Arena. Arena is a cross-platform sandboxing framework with built-in profiling workflows. It manages the lifecycle of a set of dependencies (databases, brokers, HTTP services) and components (your applications) as a single sandbox you can open, interact with, and close - giving you repeatable, deterministic, multi-service environments with a fast feedback loop. Arena provides top-level clients for Python, Java, Go, and .NET (the Python client arena-pytest, Java client arena-junit, and .NET client arena-xunit all ship today; a Go client is planned). Component testing is one common use case, but Arena is equally at home as a local development sandbox, a scripted scenario driver, or anywhere else you need a reproducible multi-service environment.
